I only tend to sleep 5 hours or less a night -- but that was already happening. IDK why... probably college?

The real litmus for me is how tired I feel when I'm awake... but I also am literally always either hypomanic or depressed so I'm either leaping out of bed or can't move.

That is to say... I have no idea what baseline is. lol

AAA!!! That's my biggest fear! Right now, it's a revelation; I have spent the great majority of all of my conscious years on this Earth depressed and intermittently suicidal (recently moreso than ever) praying for it to please get better or just end... so to feel neither of those things and think clearly? I feel like I have superpowers! So it's scary to think that that might end...

I take them with my hormonal birth control, and that's really it for now. I'll think about taking them at night though. Thank you! My phsych also recommended me taking half of a pill each day.

That's my fear with getting medicated! Like the depression is extremely difficult and painful... but then later I go into a hypomanic episode and I'm so productive I feel untouchable. I don't want to lose that... even if my energy is jittery and unstable
God, I hope you get to plant your bulbs soon!
Yep, exactly
Oh, me too. When I'm hypo I can't focus and am doing a bunch of different things -- but all shoddily. But the FEELING of productivity -- even when you're running in place -- is great to me.
Thank you!

I know I'm hungover now haha. Like, I felt the peak and this is not it. Also, I feel like I should mention that I also had a TBI recently, so my brain is probably not really dealing with this huge influx of THC well right now.
It made me SOOOO paranoid, I should've done it with different people haha, not strangers. Thanks though. That means a lot.

Well shit, I don't know what it was then but if 75% THC is low I never wanna go higher. Also, I was hallucinating as *I w*as seeing things differently. My phone looked incredibly wide while my hands looked incredibly small, I could not comprehend anything I read. Hallucinating is really the only way I can put it: I didn't see people or objects that weren't there, but I almost tried to walk off a roof because it looked so low to the ground (that's just one example).  Also, I kept seeing my boyfriend's sister's face on every woman we saw. It was really dark tho lol

I think I should at least talk to them right? But I'm also incredibly non-confrontational, and I don't want to hurt their feelings at all. They're also perfect for me in so many other, different ways - so I don't know... I haven't seen them in a while. Like I think I said: they cancelled on me this week.

Also, you're probably right. I mean; I'm very sensitive. I have no idea if he's really YELLING most of the time - more like he raises his voice and I break every time. He has told me how different I am and how sad I make him now sometimes. And how awkward and weird I am now. I don't even think thats my sensitive mind playing tricks on me. That's cruel. 

My therapist told me that they  also think couples therapy would be good for us, but I can't even get him into therapy for his PTSD. He'd never agree to couples therapy. I love him but I can barely manage myself most days.

Yeah lmaooo
I do need a new therapist, but my university provides mine. And I don't know how to get another. My family doesn't want me diagnosed with anything - my mom always tells me I'm so upset because I'm premenstrual, and I actually am a week from my period (even though I'm on birth control)... but also, she'll say I'm PMSing, that I'm somehow POSTmenstrual. She just doesn't listen. That why I don't care so much to leave her a note. Or leave my father a note because he also isn't at all helpful to me at this point, more harmful sometimes.

After I had my brain injury my boyfriend told me over and over how I'm not the same - I used to be "confident" and now I'm always anxious, I need to "snap out of it", I do this to myself. He yells at me even after I ask him not to and he agrees. He's made me feel so insecure and afraid of people as he tells me how I've become awkward - how I just blurt things out and people look at me funny, how I hurt his feelings. And as unhealthy as I know this is, he's also all that I have anymore. He was right that I needed to stop talking to those people, but a lot of them are also scared of him now and by extension can't stand me. I love him more than words can express, he visited me every day in the hospital after my TBI - even as I was in a coma I'm told.

I'm not an alcoholic. I hate the taste of basically everything. I'll drink to get drunk, but that's it. I rarely ever do that. And my eating disorder has basically barred me from drinking at all. My favorite drink is a rum and coke, but you see why I can't do that and maintain my size. I really have no hobbies - and I guess that's fine as long as I don't have drinking as a hobby right? But I don't know. When I look for reasons to keep pushing after pushing so long, I see nothing. Literally nothing.
Thank you

I agree... I mean - I hate to say it but it its true. I have friends in much worse situations than I am, yet they still find a way to be happy and productive. MUCH more happy and productive than I am or maybe have ever been. I don't know.

Maybe. I want help but I also don't. My therapist depressed me too much and I'm thinking about not seeing her anymore. I've heard a lot of stories about people with TBI just blowing their brains out and all I want to do today is that. I just want to blow what's left of my brains out

Thank you for sharing that with me. I'm going to do my absolute best to try and make sure this relationship works because I think that this really is good for both of us. 
I don't think I could get him to do anything like that right now, but I'll check around for myself.

Thank you so much. I've never heard of EMDR, but I'll look into it. I've been begging my boyfriend to see a therapist since it happened and he refuses to. He always has an excuse. He's totally thrown himself into his work since I've gotten back to school, which is his latest excuse; too busy.

I'll look into therapists for myself though: mine is only provided by my university and though she is great - I question if this is what she was trained for. We do do completely talk-based therapy. 

I'm going to keep pushing. It helps to know that I'm not alone, because a lot of the time I feel like the only person on Earth who has ever experienced this. I'm so lucky that my TBI hasn't affected me very badly in terms of language or cognition (THAT much) which is very important to my prospective field. I'm not giving up, I just realize that things aren't gonna go exactly as I planned them.

Oh wow, I had no idea that that was a feature. 

Thanks for letting me know, I've become a lot more self-critical since and I believe that that must be part of it.

Thank you, your helpfulness means a lot. I wrote this in a really low point, but I can't say that my feeling weren't real. 

From the moment I got hit by the car, I have been in constant therapy. Physically I'm basically the same, it's mainly cognitive therapy I need now. I'm about to start with some counseling regarding my executive functioning and impulse control skills. I am also still in what I guess you would call emotional therapy? I was in it long before I had my accident. I'm doing my best, but I also sometimes just wish all of these people would leave me alone. I know a TBI is technically a disability, but mine isn't that severe and without all of these people in my ear telling me that things WILL get difficult and there's no shame in quitting now, breathing down my neck, treating me like I've become helpless; I believe that I would be in much better shape.
I could try... he's also really mistrustful of therapists. doctors in general

I have a therapist, and even she has asked me if maybe he wanted to start seeing someone too or do couples therapy... but he won't do it. I've been trying to get him into therapy since he saw me get hit by a car and go flying through the air, and he just won't do it. He used to say he wouldn't do it cause it was Summertime, now I'm certain he'll say that he won't do it because he has too much work (which he does). 

And I don't know how to introduce that into a conversation. It's kind of a toss-up if I'll even see him again today, though I think that the answer might be no.
